title: Native shared run collections and full detail
description: Run on the owned iOS simulator or Android emulator against an isolated authenticated gateway. Set FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, GATEWAY_PORT, METRO_PORT, PLATFORM, FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1 and FARMSLOT_NATIVE_RUN_RECEIPT to a new private receipt path. Select IOS_SIMULATOR or the owned emulator serial. A disposable worker file drives the real production inbox; helper teardown removes only its fixture. Set FARMSLOT_RUN_PROOF_FIXTURE to the private mirror fixture for full-run and recipe observation proof. Set FARMSLOT_AGENT_DEVICE_STATE_DIR to a private per-device runner directory. The recipe cold-restarts the app with the owned gateway stopped, checks the saved full run and its actual age banner, then verifies current reconnect. Gate command refusal remains for the rest of this migration. Swipe coordinates use native units: defaults are iOS points; the owned 1080x2424 Android device uses inbox_swipe_x=86 inbox_swipe_y=620 inbox_swipe_distance=1120. The worker decision remains pending through the single iOS cold collection pass and is deliberately resolved only after recovery. Android execution requires separate lead steering. D05 requires a clean read-only dry-preflight plan in FARMSLOT_D05_PLAN and its exact resolved title in FARMSLOT_D05_DETAIL_TITLE plus the detail_title recipe parameter. Root owns one simulator boot and serial execution; the intentional offline app cold restart is permitted. Stop on a non-product failure.

proofTargets.claim: A worker-created file decision reaches the native shared cache and visible inbox without Refresh.
A real second-client resolve removes the physical decision file and the native shared-cache projection.
The actual native evidence screen observes the owned full run and recipe groups through the shared cache, matching the gateway full output and decision payloads.
A new offline app runtime restores the exact saved full run and observation age from SQLite, visibly renders its saved age and run title, and becomes current after the owned gateway restarts.
One offline cold restart preserves nonempty saved Runs and Inbox IDs and observation times from SQLite, renders age, disables a real decision action, and recovers without replay.

seed.intent: Write one private worker decision and await its real native observation.

arrival-proof.intent: Require a current decision observation backed by the actual native store.

visible.intent: Require the actual native inbox to render the worker decision.

capture.intent: The native inbox shows the worker's pending decision.

resolve.intent: A second client removes the real decision file and native inbox row.

removal-proof.intent: The current native inbox excludes the resolved decision.

inbox-top.intent: Show the newest pending decision at the start of the inbox.

open-detail.intent: Open the real run evidence screen and compare its observed full detail with the gateway.

detail-proof.intent: Require the actual mounted screen to observe current full detail and recipe groups.

detail-visible.intent: The owned run is visible on the native evidence screen.

detail-capture.intent: Record the owned full-run evidence screen.

cold-detail.intent: Warm actual Runs and Inbox, retain worker decision, cold restart once offline, prove SQLite IDs/age/disabled actions and recover once. iOS only.

cold-detail-proof.intent: Require cold SQLite restoration, actual native rendering and a current reconnect read.

cold-runs-proof.intent: Require cold saved run IDs, timestamps, actual SQLite and visible saved-age row.

cold-inbox-proof.intent: Require nonempty cold decision IDs/timestamps and actual rendered inbox.

cold-disabled-proof.intent: Require an actual disabled action tap with no decision side effect.

cold-no-replay-proof.intent: Require current recovery without replay before deliberate external resolve.
